# name purpose

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:namePurpose`](gmeow-namePurpose.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/namePurpose>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The intrinsic kind/purpose(s) of an appellation (legal, birth, chosen, professional, deadname, …) — a [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](../classes/gmeow-NamePurpose.md) value. Non-functional: a name may be both legal and chosen.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) -> [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](../classes/gmeow-NamePurpose.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:namePurpose`](gmeow-namePurpose.md) from [`gmeow:Appellation`](../classes/gmeow-Appellation.md) to [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](../classes/gmeow-NamePurpose.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Example Snippets

These snippets are generated from canonical slice examples and trimmed to the Turtle blocks where this term appears.

### Person Names

- **Source:** [`slices/core/names/examples/person-names.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/names/examples/person-names.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-names-examples-person-names)#example-slices-core-names-examples-person-names

```turtle
# --- The chosen legal name, decomposed into ordered parts (displayable).
ex:nameChosen a gmeow:PersonName ;
    gmeow:fullName "Robin Avery Chen"@en ;
    gmeow:namePurpose gmeow:namePurposeChosen ;
    gmeow:displayable true ;
    gmeow:hasNamePart ex:partGiven , ex:partMiddle , ex:partSurname .

# --- The superseded deadname: RETAINED (the record stays auditable) but
#     displayable false, so no projection ever surfaces it (P10).
ex:nameDead a gmeow:PersonName ;
    gmeow:fullName "Jordan Chen"@en ;
    gmeow:namePurpose gmeow:namePurposeDeadname ;
    gmeow:displayable false .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag the intrinsic kind(s) of an appellation — legal, birth, chosen, professional, endonym, exonym, deadname — referencing [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](../classes/gmeow-NamePurpose.md) value individuals.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using purpose to rank names (endonym and exonym are co-equal, not preferred-vs-alternate) and avoid the USAGE register here — purpose is intrinsic to the name, register is a fact of the use ([`gmeow:usageRegister`](gmeow-usageRegister.md)).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:NamePurpose`](../classes/gmeow-NamePurpose.md) individuals to an appellation (non-functional — a name may be both legal and chosen); pair a deadname purpose with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false for suppression.

### Examples

- ex:chosenName [`gmeow:namePurpose`](gmeow-namePurpose.md) [`gmeow:namePurposeChosen`](../individuals/gmeow-namePurposeChosen.md), [`gmeow:namePurposeLegal`](../individuals/gmeow-namePurposeLegal.md).
